name: What permits are required for multi-room remodeling in Oakland and the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for multi-room remodeling in Oakland and the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-room remodeling projects in Oakland and the wider East Bay region often require various permits from local building departments. These can include permits for structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, and mechanical systems. The specific permits needed depend on the scope of your project and local regulations. Frasheski Construction handles all necessary permit applications and ensures compliance with all local building codes, simplifying the process for you.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits for multi-room remodeling in Oakland and East Bay are often required for structural, electrical, and plumbing work; we handle all applications.
